'''Nesebar''' ({{langx|bg|Несебър}}) is a [[Bulgaria]]n [[municipality|municipal]] ({{langx|bg|общински, pronounced obshtinski}}) [[association football]] club based in [[Nesebar]], [[Burgas Province]], currently competing in the Second League, the second tier of Bulgarian football. 

The club’s greatest success was promotion to the [[First Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|A Group]] in [[2004–05 A Group|2004]], where the team played one season before being relegated."}}
